requiredFindings.location: reference/discovery_scan_reference.py walker_population/admit and subtree pruning branch
requiredFindings.title: Pruned entries retain unobserved VCS annotations
requiredFindings.finding: admit copies the complete synthetic directory entry, including vcs, before pruning. SLM finish collects any descendant directory with vcs directly as a nested repository. Thus an anchor itself with vcs=True becomes both a pruned tree and a nested repository even though its children were correctly omitted. Native lstat metadata cannot provide the VCS annotation without observing inside that pruned directory.
requiredFindings.reproduction: With explicitProject=/h/w and cwd=/h/w, supply /h/w/.opensip as a custody-passing directory with vcs=True. current accepts and reports nestedRepositories=["/h/w/.opensip"] plus its custody pruned row. The same occurs for node_modules, .git and target (with root Cargo.toml).
requiredFindings.requiredChange: Project synthetic entries to evidence actually observed. Preserve kind/identity for a pruned anchor but do not carry VCS/boundary annotations whose evidence is inside it into SLM finish. Retain legitimate upward/root VCS provenance separately. Add direct entry-field and output controls for all four pruning reasons with vcs=True and a hidden .git marker.

requiredFindings.location: reference/discovery_scan_reference.py subtree boundary(c) branch and depth handling
requiredFindings.title: Boundary detection observes config below the depth listing limit
requiredFindings.finding: The parent loop calls boundary(c) and retains c/opensip.json before the queued-directory depth guard runs. For an ordinary directory at depth 257 containing opensip.json, this bypasses the stated four-marker-only observation rule: the config enters the population and the directory is reported as a nested project. Its contents were not permitted to be listed or probed for config at that depth.
requiredFindings.reproduction: Supply a chain of 257 d segments below /h/w, with opensip.json at its deepest directory, explicitProject=/h/w, cwd=/h/w. current retains that config path in the downward population and reports one nestedProjects entry at depth 257.
requiredFindings.requiredChange: Apply the depth observation policy before consulting child-boundary evidence. At depth 257 keep only the permitted marker-name observations, without opensip.json or derived VCS evidence; retain nothing deeper. Add config and VCS boundary cases at 256/257/258, asserting exact populations as well as result rows.
